items.jp: 明日は1時限分の授業があります。
semantic_checks: Half-width 1 with 時限分 expresses a quantity of one class period, not an ordinal class position.
The sentence says that one period's worth of class is available tomorrow.
Do not add a subject, school, or exact start time.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not name the subject, school, or attendee.

stable: The phrase counts class-period units with 時限分, without the ordinal suffix 目.
changed: This row uses half-width 1 and 明日.
limits: The reference may use 節課 or 堂課.

items.jp: 来週は３時限分の授業があります。
semantic_checks: Full-width ３ with 時限分 expresses a quantity of three class periods, not the third class period.
The sentence says that three periods' worth of class is available next week.

stable: The phrase counts class-period units with 時限分, without the ordinal suffix 目.
changed: This row uses full-width ３ and 来週.

items.level_approx: N5-oriented provisional diagnostic; no official JLPT or certification claim
items.jp: 今日は二時間の授業があります。
semantic_checks: 二時間 expresses a two-hour duration, not two class periods and not the second class period.
Preserve the duration of the class without converting it to a number of periods.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not identify the subject, attendee, or exact schedule.

stable: Both sentences describe class time on a named day and include the number two in kanji.
changed: This row uses 時間 for a two-hour duration; CP-N5-03 uses 時限分 for two class-period units.
limits: A two-hour class must not be translated as two separate classes or as the second period.
